title: sign() uses SystemTime::now() internally — undocumented, not injectable
description: sign.rs line 217: make_signing_time_attribute() calls x509_cert::time::Time::now() for the signing-time signed attribute. This is not documented in the sign() public API. Callers who need reproducible output (e.g. for testing determinism or timestamp overriding) have no way to inject a time. The boundary is already deterministic (from content hash); adding a 'now' parameter to sign() (defaulting to SystemTime::now()) would be consistent with verify()'s explicit 'now' parameter design.
